description: Initial deterministic evaluation set for the multi-agent SQL/data analyst.

cases.description: Calculate total units purchased across all order items.
cases.question: How many units have been purchased in total?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items

cases.description: Use the business-defined discounted revenue formula.
cases.question: What is our total revenue?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount)) AS total_revenue FROM order_items
cases.expected_answer: A single total revenue value calculated after applying discounts.

cases.description: Calculate total units using the quantity metric definition.
cases.question: Show total units sold.
cases.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items

cases.description: Return the five products with the highest discounted revenue.
cases.question: Show the top 5 products by revenue.
cases.expected_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5
cases.expected_answer: Five products ordered from highest to lowest revenue.

cases.description: Rank products by total units sold in descending order.
cases.question: Which products sold the most units?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
cases.expected_answer: Products ordered from highest to lowest units sold.

cases.description: Calculate revenue only for delivered orders.
cases.question: What is the revenue from delivered orders?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'Delivered'
cases.expected_answer: Revenue generated by delivered orders only.

cases.description: Calculate revenue for orders placed during 2025.
cases.question: What was our revenue in 2025?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2025
cases.expected_answer: Revenue for orders placed in calendar year 2025.
